buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions for CCTV AMC 1. The AMC shall be valid for a period of 12 months from the date of comme ncement or as specified in the GeM contract. 2. The service provider shall carry out preventive maintenance at least on ce every quarter (or as specified by the buyer) to ensure proper functioni ng of the CCTV system. 3. Breakdown complaints shall be attended within 24 hours of reporting, and the fault shall be rectified within 48 hours, subject to the availability o f spare parts. 4. The AMC shall include: Inspection and cleaning of cameras, DVR/NVR, SMPS, monitors, and a ccessories. Checking power supply, connectors, network cables, and storage devi ces. Software/firmware updates wherever applicable. Health check of the complete CCTV system. Submission of preventive maintenance reports after every visit. 5. In the case of a Comprehensive AMC (CAMC), all spare parts (except co nsumables or excluded items) shall be supplied and replaced without addit ional cost. In a Non-Comprehensive AMC, only service charges are inclu ded, and spare parts shall be charged separately after approval. 6. The contractor shall deploy qualified and experienced service engineers for maintenance work.

7. Emergency service support shall be available on all working days. Critical c omplaints shall be given priority. 8. Any defective equipment removed for repair shall be replaced temporarily with an equivalent unit, if repair is expected to take more than the agreed downtime. 9. The bidder shall maintain a service register/logbook recording complain t details, preventive maintenance visits, and rectification reports. 10. The buyer may impose penalties for delays in attending complaints or fail ure to meet service levels as per GeM contract conditions. 11. Payment shall be released on a quarterly/half-yearly basis (or as per th e GeM contract) after satisfactory completion of services and submission o f service reports. 12. The bidder shall ensure that all maintenance activities are carried out with out disrupting the buyer's normal operations. 13. Any damage caused by negligence of the service provider during maintena nce shall be repaired or replaced by the service provider at no additional c ost. 14. The bidder shall comply with all applicable GeM General Terms and Con ditions, safety regulations, and statutory requirements. 15. AMC charges quoted on GeM should be inclusive of GST, and GeM comm only requires AMC charges to be quoted as a percentage of the equipment cost after the warranty period. These clauses are consistent with common GeM AMC bid conditions and buyer- added terms used in CCTV maintenance tenders. .
